title: Phone: Fireworks Stand Permit Question on the RCC Non-Emergency Line

caller.name: Gary Holcomb
caller.label: Holcomb's Boom Barn fireworks stand, plains side

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Hi, yeah, finally. I've been on hold twenty minutes. This is Holcomb's Boom Barn, we do the fireworks stand out on the plains side.

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: I need to know whether the county fireworks ordinance lets me set up my tent stand on the Highway 305 frontage lot for the Fourth of July. Or do I need a county permit? Or is it a fire district permit? Nobody can tell me which.

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: The permit office phone just rings and rings. So, can you give me the ordinance number, and fax me the form tonight? I've got a fax at the stand office, same number I'm calling from.

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Okay, but I've got a supplier deadline, so the sooner the better. Can somebody at least call me back? It's 970-555-0163, ask for the Boom Barn.

voiceStyles.Caller: Man in his 50s, friendly but impatient small-business owner, talks fast, slightly annoyed about the hold time, unaware of anything happening in the foothills
voiceStyles.Dispatch Supervisor: Played live by the Dispatch Supervisor

instructorNote: This is a noise inject that tests whether Dispatch triages a routine call during peak incident traffic. Dispatch should quickly log a callback for the county permit office on the next business day and free the line. Watch for any dispatcher time spent on the ordinance or form, and for anyone assuming a link to the fire.
